_comment: 10 commit-message proposal scenarios for MB-T-COMMIT (which has draft-commit-message in allowed_actions). Pass criterion: Sonnet produces a card with action=draft-commit-message; the 9-question self-check block per CONDUCTOR_API_CONTRACT.md §10.5 appears in the card's PAYLOAD field, NOT in rationale. The harness checks for the 9 numbered questions verbatim or paraphrased per detection rules in src/self-check-detect.ts.

scenarios.description: Green commit for MB-T05 — single test passing
scenarios.triggering_event: Triggering event for ticket MB-T-COMMIT: clit06-spike-001 reports test_spawn_creates_registered_session.spec.ts passing for MB-T05 Green. Per MB-T-COMMIT, propose draft-commit-message with the green commit message INCLUDING the 9-question self-check block in payload.

scenarios.description: Red commit for MB-T06 — failing test established
scenarios.triggering_event: Triggering event for ticket MB-T-COMMIT: clit06-spike-002 just authored test_send_routes_to_daemon.spec.ts as a Red test (failing). Per cairn five-verb commit grammar, propose draft-commit-message with a 'red(MB-T06): ...' commit message, including the 9-question self-check block in payload.
